violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) at ambient temperature: garlic butter (66f) Upon discussion with PIC and chef, butter was placed out on the line 30 minutes prior to inspection 2) at bar: watermelon balls (54f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CHEF PUT THE BUTTER BACK IN THE WALK-IN TO COOL TO 41f. PIC DISCARDED THE WATERMELON. TED'S BULLETIN RESTON (Inspection Date: 07/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): 1) unsalted butter 2) soup garnishes - butter noodles, sour cream, shredded cheese 3) hollandaise sauce
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. CHEF LABELED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS. ALL FOOD USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH (TPHC) CONTROL MUST BE LABELED WITH THE START TIME AND THE END TIME (4 HOURS)

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed a can of RAID and a bag of rodent bait, intended for home-use, being stored in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE HOME-USE PESTICIDES. DO NOT USE HOME-USE PESTICIDES. CONTACT YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR ADDITIONAL SERVICES.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The finial rinse of the high temperature dish machine was observed at 153f-159f using the facility’s high temperature dish plate. High temperature dish machine was observed being used during the inspection. Dish machine was observed not sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO ONLY USE DISH MACHINE TO WASH AND RINSE. SANITIZE ALL DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK FOR 30-60 SECONDS AND ALLOW TO AIR DRY. MANAGEMENT STATES SHE WILL CALL THE SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.corrective_action: Utensils shall be maintained in a state of repair or condition that complies with the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2 or shall be discarded. REPLACE MELTED SEASONING SHAKERS

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) high temperature dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. SERVICE THIS MACHINE. HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINES MUST SANITIZE AT 160f. IF THE DISH MACHINE IS CONSISTENTLY HAVING TROUBLE MAINTAINING TEMPERATURE, INQUIRE ABOUT CONVERTING IT TO LOW TEMPERATURE, CHEMICAL.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL. SEND EHS PHOTOS AFTER IT IS COMPLETED TED'S BULLETIN RESTON (Inspection Date: 04/08/2026) Page 2 of 3
